best_first_spike.title: Attribute filesystem work in ordinary policy-rich checks
best_first_spike.first_discriminator: Measure eager size-validator metadata calls with no size policy; then attribute duplicate enumeration and content reads.
deliverables: keep/defer decision under existing strict gates
dependencies: targeted-check coverage contract before incremental eligibility changes
best_first_spike.current_head_gate_separate: NU11/R02/R03 many-scope no-slower evidence is not explained by rich-engine hypotheses.

existing_evidence.amdahl: Unknown measured fractions; use 1/(1-f) only after same-operation attribution. Separate phase medians are not an end-to-end decomposition.

hypotheses.title: Demand-driven filesystem metadata
hypotheses.classification: source-proven avoidable work; latency opportunity unverified
hypotheses.applicable: Full-engine checks with FileBundle rules and no applicable max-size rule
hypotheses.cost: Up to one avoidable stat-family call per matching file; O(N) calls
hypotheses.profile: Attribute stat-family counts and CPU/wall time to size validation; no-size policy negative control
hypotheses.smallest_candidate: Guard absent size policy before fetching metadata; no new abstraction
hypotheses.disposition: first discriminator in one bounded spike

hypotheses.title: Share identical-scope enumeration within one check
hypotheses.classification: duplicate walks and reads established; wall fraction unverified
hypotheses.applicable: Policy-rich root/subtree checks with multiple extension consumers and aggregate rules
hypotheses.cost: O(K*N) discovery can approach O(N) plus policy evaluation; preserve streaming naming path
hypotheses.profile: Count directory/file opens, walks, bytes and peak memory by consumer
hypotheses.smallest_candidate: Reuse test-relationship project listing when checked scope equals root, or one docs active/status selector pass
hypotheses.disposition: next observation in same spike; defer general inventory

hypotheses.title: Bound scope candidate matching in rich/glob-heavy policies
hypotheses.classification: O(D*S) source risk; not established dominant bottleneck
hypotheses.applicable: Many uncached directories and overlapping or wildcard scope configurations
hypotheses.cost: Reduce candidate predicates below D*S while preserving current resolver; static fast scopes already indexed
hypotheses.profile: Vary scopes independently from paths/depth; count predicates, setup allocations and public wall time
hypotheses.smallest_candidate: Candidate prefilter/index feeding unchanged composition order

hypotheses.title: Proven dependency classes for incremental reuse
hypotheses.classification: conservative fallback established; eligibility expansion unverified
hypotheses.applicable: Repeated single-edit and burst feedback with locally decidable rich policy
hypotheses.cost: Potential N to changed m plus dependents; must preserve project-wide fallback
hypotheses.profile: Actual adapter idle/edit/burst/config/deletion with actual validation counts and coverage
hypotheses.smallest_candidate: One truly local rule class after coverage contract is settled
hypotheses.disposition: extend existing outcome; no duplicate fast-hook item
hypotheses.keep_stop: Identical required findings/coverage; observed work reduction and actual adapter p95 improvement. Preserve CF03 targets idle <=25 ms, injected <=50 ms, structural edit <=100 ms, plus cold/native/warm gates. Stop on incomplete invalidation or no actual adapter benefit.

limitations: No runtime attribution or fresh benchmark generated
Historical phase medians cannot determine current Amdahl fraction
Root supplied targeted-check release reproduction; source independently inspected
